pr_body:
##### SUMMARY
This PR is a simple rebase of @relrod's #74224 onto the current devel branch. Credit for all relevant work is theirs.
From the original PR:
- `skip_broken` was set in config but not actually used in calls to `base.install()`
- Added a lot of test cases with specialized repo
- Got rid of external (docker repo) nobest test cases since the specialized repo works well for those too
- Slight cleanup and adding comments in dnf module

Fixes #73072

##### ISSUE TYPE
- Bugfix Pull Request
- Test Pull Request

##### COMPONENT NAME
dnf

##### ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
Fixes a bug known since December 2020, wherein the dnf module would not respond to the `skip_broken` parameter being set. Further details available in #73072 and #74224.
pr_comments:
I'm not sure if this works for other PRs, but:
Closes #74224

<!--- boilerplate: components_banner --->

Verified. This is because even though we set `strict` (aka `skip_broken`) in the dnf base config, we don't actually pass it as `strict` (kwarg) when we call `base.install()`: https://github.com/ansible/ansible/blob/devel/lib/ansible/modules/dnf.py#L743

There are a few other places as well. I'm working on a patch and was writing a bunch of test cases, but it was on my desktop and my power just went out, so my work got stalled :laughing: -- I'll have a patch up soonish.
